title: ToolSchema
description: Agentool's internal data model for a wrapped API. Every parser path (OpenAPI 3.x, HTML inference, browser recording) emits exactly one ToolSchema. The MCP server consumes one.

tool_id.description: Stable machine-readable identifier for this tool (e.g. "github", "stripe").

version.description: Semver string for this schema snapshot.

base_url.description: Root URL that all method paths are appended to.

methods.description: All callable methods this tool exposes to the agent.

components.description: Named reusable type definitions. Methods reference these via { "$ref": "#/components/<Name>" }.

Auth.description: Authentication specification for the upstream API.

type.description: Authentication scheme. "none" means no credentials required.

in.description: Transport location for the credential. Required for bearer, api_key, and basic.

name.description: Header or query-parameter name that carries the credential (e.g. "Authorization", "X-API-Key").

scheme.description: Value prefix placed before the token. Used only for bearer (e.g. "Bearer").

RateLimit.description: Token-bucket rate-limit applied per tool before each upstream call.

burst.description: Maximum burst capacity above the sustained rate.

Method.description: A single callable operation exposed to the agent as an MCP tool.

name.description: Snake-case identifier exposed to the agent (e.g. "search_repositories").

description.description: Human-readable docstring shown to the LLM to explain what this method does.

params.description: Input parameters the agent must or may supply.

returns.description: Shape of the successful response value.

HttpSpec.description: The HTTP verb and path that implement this method.

path.description: URL path relative to base_url. Path parameters use {param_name} syntax.

Param.description: A single input parameter for a method.

name.description: Parameter name as expected by the upstream API.

in.description: Where in the HTTP request this parameter is placed.

required.description: Whether the agent must supply this parameter.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what this parameter controls.

enum.description: If present, restricts the parameter value to one of these literal strings.

ReturnType.description: Describes the shape of a method's return value or a nested collection element.

kind.description: Top-level type of the return value.

fields.description: Named fields present when kind is "object".

items.description: Element type present when kind is "array". Either an inline ReturnType or a $ref to components.

ReturnField.description: A single named field inside an object return type.

name.description: Field name as it appears in the JSON response.

type.description: JSON-compatible scalar or collection type of this field.

items.description: Element type present when type is "array". Either an inline ReturnType or a $ref to components.

ComponentRef.description: A reference to a named type in the top-level components map.

$ref.description: JSON pointer into the components map (e.g. "#/components/Repository").

Provenance.description: Records how and when this ToolSchema was produced.

source.description: Which parser path produced this schema.

fetched_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the source was fetched or the recording completed.

source_url.description: URL of the OpenAPI spec or docs page this schema was derived from. Omitted for browser_record provenance.
